content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Mahabubnagar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://ecourts.gov.in/Mahabubnagar. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications for DLSA Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Assistant and Typist-Cum-Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the District Legal Services Authority Mahabubnagar for the posts of Junior Assistant and Typist-Cum-Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 44 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Typist-Cum-Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Typist-Cum-Assistant post, candidates must hold a Degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, or Law, along with passing the Government Technical Examination in Typewriting Higher Grade in English (45 w.p.m.) and possess computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 800/-. SC/ST candidates are required to pay Rs. 400/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DLSA Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an OMR-based Written Examination, a Skill Test (for Typist-Cum-Assistant), an Oral Interview (Viva-voce), Document Verification, and the final Merit List preparation.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for DLSA Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for DLSA Mahabubnagar?
faq.answer: The official website for District Legal Services Authority Mahabubnagar is http://ecourts.gov.in/Mahabubnagar. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations available for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. There is a 5-year relaxation for SCs/STs/BCs/EWS candidates and a 10-year relaxation for Differently-abled individuals, as per rules for Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the application form.
